open.title: Copywriter
open.blurb: Twelve words, if you have them. Eleven, if you do not.

open.title: Jingle Writer
open.blurb: Must hum on demand. A piano is not provided.

open.title: Paste-up Artist
open.blurb: A steel rule, a sharp blade, and no patience for a crooked margin.

open.title: Retoucher
open.blurb: The face is already good. You will make it printable.

open.title: Media Buyer
open.blurb: Knows which hour of the afternoon a spot can still afford.

open.title: TV Producer
open.blurb: Says “that’s a wrap” at four, and means lunch.

open.title: Switchboard Operator
open.blurb: The first hello and the last goodbye, and never a crossed line.

open.title: Chauffeur
open.blurb: The car is black. The route is a matter of opinion.

open.title: Mailroom Boy
open.blurb: The chute, the stairs, and the one envelope that is always late.

open.title: Tea Lady
open.blurb: The kettle is a department. Biscuits are a philosophy.
